method: Compare explicit canonical typed reward relationships against the 24-PQ late-DLC scope. Missing typed relationships are coverage targets only; absence is not interpreted as proof that the PQ has no such reward.
findings: All six final Future Saga Chapter 3/4 skill reward endpoints (PQ183-PQ186) are already represented canonically: Emperor's Cannon, Chaotic Time Impact, Dragon Spiral, Indomitable, and Venus Fist.

Late-DLC Super Soul coverage is sparse but patterned: explicit relationships are present for PQ164, 166, 168, 173, 175, 177, 178, 180, and 182-186; missing IDs are research targets and are not asserted to have no Super Soul rewards.
Late-DLC equipment coverage is also sparse and requires evidence-driven expansion; missing IDs are not interpreted as empty reward pools.
Skill coverage in this range is complete for every PQ with documented canonical skill rewards; the remaining global 16-PQ skill-endpoint gap lies outside this 163-186 range.
